name: SAAT-AATH
description: Saat-Aath is a two-player Indian trick-taking game in the 3-2-5 family. A 30-card pack is used, the non-dealer calls trumps, and players contest 15 tricks with quotas of 7 for the dealer and 8 for the non-dealer.

content.text: Saat-Aath is a two-player Indian trick-taking game in the 3-2-5 family. A 30-card pack is used, the non-dealer calls trumps, and players contest 15 tricks with quotas of 7 for the dealer and 8 for the non-dealer.
Saat-Aath is a two-player adaptation of the South Asian three-player quota game 3-2-5.
Exactly 2 players; dealer alternates by deal.
Start from 52 cards and remove all 2-6 plus 7 of clubs and 7 of diamonds. Trumps rank: 7 of hearts (highest), 7 of spades, then A K Q J 10 9 8 of trump suit. Non-trump suits rank A K Q J 10 9 8.
30-card pack and optional score sheet for match play.

Dealer gives 5 hand cards to each player. Non-dealer calls trump. Dealer then deals 5 face-down table cards in a row to each player and places 1 face-up card on each stack, giving each player 15 playable cards over time.

items.text: No Special Sevens: 7 of hearts and 7 of spades lose permanent trump privilege and become normal low cards of their printed suits.
Winner Draw Advantage: As in some 3-2-5 circles, previous winner draws cards from loser before next deal according to margin over quota.
